summary: Franklin County, FL lattice observation tower; a 2005 state surplus sale is the only dated record, and no source read confirms it still stands.

facts.status_note: Only dated record is a 2005 surplus sale; no source read says whether the tower was moved or still stands

events.note: Bids opened to sell the tower as state surplus; winning bid $1,100

evidence.supports: tower is listed in Franklin County

evidence.quote: September 14, 2005: Bids were opened for the sale of the tower, winning bid was $1100.00.

evidence.supports: surplus process: high bidder dismantles and moves the tower
evidence.quote: The high bidder is expected to dismantle and deliver the tower to its new destination.

evidence.supports: fire towers usually dismantled in sections with a crane
evidence.quote: Fire towers are usually dismantled in sections with the assistance of a buyer-provided crane

evidence.supports: OpenStreetMap tags the tower as lattice construction
OpenStreetMap tags the tower as an observation tower

sources.title: Surplus Equipment and Fire Towers
sources.publisher: Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services

corrections.why: The only dated record is a 2005 sale of the tower as surplus, and OpenStreetMap carries no status tag, so 'standing' is not supported by any source read.

notes_for_editor: Thin: a short Forest Lookouts entry (county and 2005 sale), OSM construction tags, and a general FDACS surplus notice that is not specific to this tower. No build date, height, builder, photo, or post-2005 record found. The Carrabelle Wikipedia article and the city history page do not mention a tower. Editor should decide whether the 2005 sale makes the record's standing status wrong, and whether to keep this record as is.
